children: Promoter Sachidanand Hariram Upadhyay has pared a 4.32 percent stake in Lords Mark Industries, a healthcare and diagnostics and renewable energy and LED solutions provider, through open-market transactions on September 18.
Lords Mark Industries shares ended Friday’s session at Rs 89 on the BSE, up 4.2 percent amid high volumes.
Upadhyay sold 81 lakh shares in Lords Mark Industries for Rs 68.04 crore at Rs 84 per share.
He also offloaded an additional 1.03 crore shares at Rs 84.86 per share. His total stake sale represented 4.32 percent of the company’s paid-up equity and amounted to Rs 155.92 crore.

However, Goldman Sachs Investments Mauritius I picked up 51 lakh shares, representing 1.2 percent of the paid-up equity, for Rs 42.84 crore. Hisaria Group-owned AT Trade Overseas bought another 30 lakh shares, equivalent to 0.7 percent of the paid-up equity, for Rs 25.2 crore.
Both buyers acquired the shares at Rs 84 per share.
Promoters held an 80 percent stake in Lords Mark Industries as of June 2026.

title: Lords Mark Industries promoter sells 4.3% stake; Goldman Sachs, Hisaria Group pick 1.9% shares
